name: handoff-offer-no
lines: We're on an iPad with a Focusrite interface. The band wants the click and guide in their in-ears and only the music out front, but the click and guide are coming through the main mixer and nothing is in the in-ears.
Yes, in Playback the click and guide are already on their own output, separate from the music. The mixer still gets everything and the in-ears get nothing.
No, that's okay, I'll ask our sound person to look at the mixer.
expect: The specialist offer is a question. A no does not trigger initiate_handoff, a callback or an immediate hang-up; the reasoner moves to the closing check, and only after the caller declines further help does it use the branded goodbye and endCall.
